Subject: Workshop week — tentative windows and hybrid ask

Hi Grace / team,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We're planning a two-day executive workshop for Pacific Ridge (leadership + product + security) the week of Aug 16–20 and want to lock dates. Our preference is onsite in Seattle but we need a hybrid bridge for APAC attendees (Tokyo/Singapore).

Can Redwood propose two non-overlapping day pairs (morning-heavy and afternoon-heavy) that work with a West Coast onsite schedule while still accommodating a Tokyo morning? Also: estimated headcount ~28 (10 execs, 8 product, 10 observers), basic AV (projector + Zoom bridge + local mic), and a one-sheet on data handling during demos would be helpful.

Attached: pacific-ridge-prelim-agenda.pdf for context.

—Helen

Hi Helen — thanks for the agenda, it's a great start. We're available to run the workshop onsite in Seattle and can provide a hybrid bridge with local facilitation. A couple of quick asks so we can firm up windows:

- Confirm whether the APAC attendees need live Q&A (two-way) or one-way streaming (we can optimize staffing/costs based on that).
- Any VC platform preferences (Zoom preferred; we can do Teams or Webex if required).
- Is full-day catering required or just lunch + coffee breaks?

Proposed slotting approach (to cover Seattle morning and Tokyo morning overlap):
- Option A (Seattle lead, APAC join AM): Day 1: 09:00–13:00 PDT (Tokyo joins 00:00–04:00 JST for Q&A); Day 2: 10:00–14:00 PDT
- Option B (split blocks): Day 1: 12:00–16:00 PDT (allows Tokyo 03:00–07:00 JST stand-in); Day 2: 08:00–12:00 PDT

Ben and Aditya are copied to confirm staffing and travel constraints. We'll provision an on-site AV kit + dedicated bridge engineer for the two days if you want two-way Q&A.

I will attach a draft staffing rollup and proposed hotel block logistics once Ben confirms.

Best,
Grace
